onClick: {{ (async () => { try { const street = inpCompanyAddressStreet.text?.trim(); const unit = inpCompanyAddressUnit.text?.trim() || null; const city = inpCompanyAddressCity.text?.trim(); const state = inpCompanyAddressState.text?.trim(); const postal = inpCompanyAddressPostal.text?.trim(); const country = inpCompanyAddressCountry.text?.trim() || 'USA'; const reason = inpCompanyAddressReason.text?.trim(); if (!street || !city || !state || !postal || !reason) { showAlert('Enter a full mailing address and reason.', 'warning'); return; } const rows = await qAddCompanyDonorAddress.run({ street, unit, city, state, postal, country, reason }); if (!rows?.[0]?.address_id) throw new Error('Address was not added.'); await Promise.all([qCompanyDonorAddresses.run(), qCompanyContacts.run()]); showAlert('Contributor address added.', 'success'); } catch (e) { showAlert('Address add failed: ' + (e?.message || e), 'error'); } })() }}
